description: What it costs to RUN the system. Operational (management) transactions — settle, payment-hook withdraw, main→pool funding, defrag (consolidate), wallet shaping (split), and standalone deposit merge — are pure overhead no client reimburses; this dashboard shows the ADA fees and counts of those txs, by kind and by signer wallet. Every panel reads the same cumulative counters (sum of the counter), so the fee and the count always agree (one settle that cost 0.79 ADA reads as count 1, fee 0.79). The counters are cumulative since the feeder process started and reset to zero on a restart — on Mainnet, where restarts are rare, this is effectively the lifetime total; in Preview, frequent restarts mean it reads the totals since the last boot. A deposit merge folded into an update tx is not counted here (it rides the update's fee). Update-tx fees are shown separately as the productive cost, offset by what clients are charged. Net cost ≈ operational overhead + max(0, update fees − client charges).

panels.description: Total ADA spent in fees by ALL management txs since the feeder started (settle/withdraw/fund/consolidate/split/merge). The headline operational overhead. Reads the cumulative fee counter directly, so it always agrees with the count panel beside it. Resets to zero when the feeder restarts; on Mainnet (rare restarts) this is the lifetime cost. Update-tx fees are excluded (see the right-hand panel).
panels.title: Operational fees — ADA (cumulative)

panels.description: Total number of confirmed management txs since the feeder started — settle/withdraw/fund/consolidate/split/merge. The count companion of the fee panel on the left: same counter source, so they always agree. Failed txs are excluded (they paid no fee). Resets on feeder restart.
panels.title: Management txs — confirmed (cumulative)

panels.description: Total ADA spent in fees by UPDATE txs (writing prices on-chain) since the feeder started — the productive cost. Shown for the net-cost picture: unlike the overhead on the left, this is offset by what clients are charged through the PaymentHook, so it is NOT added to the running-cost figure. Keyed by symbol/client, so the $wallet and $kind filters do not apply to it. Resets on feeder restart.
panels.title: Update-tx fees — ADA (cumulative)

panels.description: ADA spent in fees per management kind since the feeder started — settle/withdraw/fund_pool/consolidate/split/merge. Shows WHICH activity drove the overhead. Sums to the headline 'Operational fees' panel, and lines up row-for-row with the count panel on the right. A kind that has not run has no row (correct, not missing). Resets on feeder restart.
panels.title: Operational fees by kind — ADA (cumulative)

panels.description: Count of confirmed management txs per kind since the feeder started. The count companion of the by-kind fee panel on the left: same counter source, same window — read them together (e.g. many cheap splits vs few pricey settles). Failed txs excluded. Resets on feeder restart.
panels.title: Management txs by kind — confirmed (cumulative)

panels.description: ADA spent in fees per SIGNER wallet since the feeder started. settle/withdraw/fund/merge are paid by the main wallet (it funds the pool, settles, and runs the standalone deposit merge); consolidate/split are paid by the pool wallet being reshaped. Shows where the overhead leaves the wallets. Resets on feeder restart.
panels.title: Operational fees by wallet — ADA (cumulative)
